mapper.sql: p.id, p.sku, p.name, p.manufacturer, p.manufacturer_part_number, p.part_number_normalized, p.variant, p.note, p.unit, p.default_vat_rate, p.sale_price, p.min_stock_level, p.quantity_on_hand, p.is_active, p.created_at, p.updated_at, AS quantity_reserved

COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) FROM "order".order_items oi JOIN "order".orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN warehouse.goods_receipt_items gri ON gri.id = oi.goods_receipt_item_id WHERE gri.product_id = p.id AND o.status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM warehouse.stock_movements m WHERE m.order_item_id = oi.id AND m.movement_type = 'ISSUE') ), 0)

where.if: AND ( LOWER(p.sku) LIKE LOWER(#{searchLike}) OR LOWER(p.name) LIKE LOWER(#{searchLike}) )
AND p.min_stock_level IS NOT NULL AND p.quantity_on_hand - < p.min_stock_level

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM warehouse.products p
ORDER BY LIMIT #{params.pageSize} OFFSET #{params.offset}

choose.when: p.sale_price DESC NULLS LAST, p.id DESC
p.unit DESC, p.name DESC, p.id DESC

mapper.select:
SELECT o.id AS orderId, o.order_number AS orderNumber,
CASE WHEN c.customer_type = 'COMPANY' THEN c.company_name ELSE c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name END AS customerName, o.status::text AS orderStatus, SUM(oi.quantity) AS quantity, MAX(oi.created_at) AS reservedAt FROM "order".order_items AS oi JOIN "order".orders AS o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN warehouse.goods_receipt_items AS gri ON gri.id = oi.goods_receipt_item_id LEFT JOIN customer.customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE gri.product_id = #{productId} AND o.status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM warehouse.stock_movements m WHERE m.order_item_id = oi.id AND m.movement_type = 'ISSUE') GROUP BY o.id, o.order_number, o.status, c.customer_type, c.company_name, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY MAX(oi.created_at) DESC

SELECT gri.id AS batchId, gri.name_snapshot AS nameSnapshot, gri.quantity_received AS quantityReceived, gri.quantity_remaining AS quantityRemaining, gri.unit_price_excl_vat AS unitPriceExclVat, gr.invoice_number AS invoiceNumber, gr.order_number AS orderNumber, gr.issue_date AS issueDate, COALESCE(s.name, gr.supplier_name_snapshot) AS supplierName FROM warehouse.goods_receipt_items gri JOIN warehouse.goods_receipts gr ON gr.id = gri.goods_receipt_id LEFT JOIN warehouse.suppliers s ON s.id = gr.supplier_id WHERE gri.product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY gr.issue_date DESC NULLS LAST, gri.id DESC

SELECT m.id AS id, m.movement_type AS movementType, m.quantity AS quantity, m.moved_at AS movedAt, m.order_id AS orderId, o.order_number AS orderNumber, m.return_reason AS returnReason, m.credit_note_number AS creditNoteNumber, m.note AS note FROM warehouse.stock_movements m LEFT JOIN "order".orders o ON o.id = m.order_id WHERE m.product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY m.moved_at DESC, m.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO warehouse.products ( sku, name, manufacturer, manufacturer_part_number, variant, note, unit, default_vat_rate, sale_price, min_stock_level, is_active ) VALUES ( #{sku}, #{name}, #{manufacturer}, #{manufacturerPartNumber}, #{variant}, #{note}, #{unit}, #{defaultVatRate}, #{salePrice}, #{minStockLevel}, COALESCE(#{active}, TRUE) )
mapper.update: UPDATE warehouse.products SET sku = #{sku}, name = #{name}, manufacturer = #{manufacturer}, manufacturer_part_number = #{manufacturerPartNumber}, variant = #{variant}, note = #{note}, unit = #{unit}, default_vat_rate = #{defaultVatRate}, sale_price = #{salePrice}, min_stock_level = #{minStockLevel} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE warehouse.products SET is_active = FALSE WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE warehouse.products SET is_active = TRUE WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM warehouse.products WHERE sku = #{sku})

SELECT
FROM warehouse.products p WHERE id IN ( SELECT gri.product_id FROM warehouse.goods_receipt_items gri WHERE gri.goods_receipt_id = #{id} )

SELECT p.id AS productId, p.sku AS sku, p.name AS name, p.unit AS unit, p.quantity_on_hand AS quantityOnHand, AS quantityReserved, p.quantity_on_hand - AS quantityAvailable, p.min_stock_level AS minStockLevel, p.min_stock_level - (p.quantity_on_hand - ) AS missingQuantity, last_supplier.supplier_id AS supplierId, s.name AS supplierName, last_supplier.supplier_sku AS supplierSku, last_supplier.last_unit_price_excl_vat AS lastUnitPriceExclVat, last_supplier.last_seen_at AS lastSeenAt FROM warehouse.products p LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT sp.supplier_id, sp.supplier_sku, sp.last_unit_price_excl_vat, sp.last_seen_at FROM warehouse.supplier_products sp WHERE sp.product_id = p.id ORDER BY sp.last_seen_at DESC, sp.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS last_supplier ON TRUE LEFT JOIN warehouse.suppliers s ON s.id = last_supplier.supplier_id WHERE p.is_active = TRUE AND p.min_stock_level IS NOT NULL
AND p.quantity_on_hand - < p.min_stock_level ORDER BY (p.min_stock_level - (p.quantity_on_hand - )) DESC, p.name
SELECT v.product_id AS productId, v.sku AS sku, v.name AS name, v.unit AS unit, v.quantity_on_hand AS quantityOnHand, v.stock_value AS stockValue FROM warehouse.v_stock_valuation v ORDER BY v.name
